description: Confirm an exact future-hire auto-assignment policy change for one existing Project To-do. First call opentrain_preflight_project_todo with operation=set_future_assignment plus the same jobId, itemId, and enabled value; then pass that request-bound signed receipt here. This changes only future-hire policy and does not fan out assignments immediately. Requires project_todos:write.

preflightReceipt.description: Signed receipt from a matching set_future_assignment preflight.

name: opentrain_set_project_todo_future_assignment
